title: Algerian Fenugreek Skillet
description: A hearty Algerian-inspired skillet dish featuring fenugreek and a variety of spices. Serve with crusty bread for a satisfying meal.
instructions: Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the diced red bell pepper and cook for 2-3 minutes.
Add the chopped fenugreek leaves and cook until wilted, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the cumin powder, paprika, salt, and black pepper. Stir to combine.
Add the chickpeas and cook for 1-2 minutes.
Add the tomato paste and stir to combine. Cook for 1-2 minutes.
Reduce heat to low and simmer for 5-7 minutes.
Taste and adjust seasoning as needed.
Serve hot with crusty bread, garnished with chopped fresh parsley or cilantro, if desired.
